# LLM cache committed outside compile transaction

LLM cache entries are documented as being committed eagerly outside the compile transaction. This can lead to LLM responses being persisted even when the associated compile run fails or is rolled back, creating potential inconsistencies between cache contents and compile state.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.LLMCacheRow`
